department: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

deadline.value: February 1 is the deadline for departmental funding; the final fall deadline is August 1.
deadline.quote: February 1 is the deadline to be considered for departmental funding

also.quote: Applications for the Fall semester must be received by August 1

supervisor.value: Admission is competitive and not tied to a named advisor; first-year students choose an advisor after one semester.
supervisor.quote: Admission to the ECE Ph.D. program is competitive. Those who meet stated requirements are not guaranteed admission

also.quote: At the end of the first semester, first year scholars will choose a doctoral advisor

funding.value: Financial support is available as research or teaching assistantships or scholarships, with a full tuition waiver.
funding.quote: Financial support is available in the form of Research Assistantships, Teaching Assistantships and Scholarships, all of them providing competitive stipends, full tuition waiver and subsidized health insurance

entry_route.value: A master's is a candidacy requirement, not an admission rule stated on the page.
entry_route.quote: Candidates must complete the course requirements for the thesis master’s degree, or have been awarded a master’s degree in electrical or computer engineering, or a closely related field

gre_subject.value: The ECE pages do not mention a GRE Subject test.

gre_general.value: The ECE pages do not mention the GRE.

notes: Competitive admission. Department pages do not give English or GRE rules, so the Graduate College rules apply.
